articles.title_zh: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
facts_zh:
Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
- Published
A US judge has ordered President Donald Trump to answer questions under oath in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by 11 December.
Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave before the riot at the US Capitol in 2021.
Trump cancelled a previous deposition - or interview under oath - on 16 October, citing "matters of national importance".

all_titles.en: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit

articles.title_original: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
articles.title_zh: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
facts_zh:
Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
- Published
A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed el-Fasher's healthcare system during their long siege and subsequent takeover of the city in Darfur a year ago.

UN human rights chief Volker Türk called the findings "deeply disturbing", saying multiple attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on civilian infrastructure, including health facilities, were serious violations of international humanitarian law and may amount to war crimes.
The RSF has rejected the BBC's findings.

all_titles.en: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds

facts_zh:
'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
- Published
Amy Acton, the Democratic candidate for governor of the US state of Ohio, has called an attack ad against her that features her estranged mother "despicable".
Acton commented on the campaign ad from her Republican opponent, Vivek Ramaswamy, on Wednesday, saying: "This is despicable, what he's done".
In the ad Acton's mother, Donna Arthur, says Acton "lied her entire life".

articles.title_original: Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots
articles.title_zh: Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots
facts_zh:
Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots
- Published
Paris is extending a partial curfew restricting movement in parts of the city until Monday, as Marseille and Lyon impose a total ban on protests this weekend.
The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums in the French capital will also be closed on Saturday as more demonstrations are expected.

France is still reeling from major disorder at the weekend, when large protests against the high cost of living and school conditions were overshadowed by riots and looting that saw business and historic buildings destroyed.

all_titles.en: Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots

articles.title_zh: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
facts_zh:
Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
- Published
Meta has agreed to a new deal with chief executive Mark Zuckerberg to prevent him from leaving California over a proposed state tax on billionaires.

The agreement gives Zuckerberg, whose wealth is estimated to exceed $200bn (£149bn), even more shares in Meta to make up for the fraction of his fortune he may lose if the tax wins voter approval in November.
The measure would impose a one-time 5% tax on residents with a net worth of more than $1bn.

all_titles.en: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax

facts_zh:
'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular pleads not guilty to rape charge
- Published
Clavicular, a social media influencer who promotes the "looksmaxxing" trend of young men maximising their attractiveness, has pleaded not guilty to criminal charges including rape.
The 20-year-old, whose real name is Braden Peters, was charged in September with felony rape, drugging an individual for sexual intercourse and procuring alcohol for someone under the age of 21.
The charges stem from an incident in 2025 when he is accused of assaulting a 17-year-old girl at his family's Massachusetts home.

Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
- Published
A foreign national has been beaten to death by a crowd of about 50 people in Durban, South Africa, police say.
According to police, the unidentified man, believed to be in his late 30s or early 40s, was first approached by two men by the roadside before being assaulted by a larger group.
He was pronounced dead at the scene.

articles.title_original: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
articles.title_zh: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
facts_zh:
Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
- Published
From the day they were born, just seven weeks ago, twins Raghad Hassan and her brother Raad have been battling for survival.
They came into the world prematurely, as fighting surged in Yemen's long-running civil war between Houthi rebel fighters and government forces.

When the Houthis reached their village in the Kahboub mountains in south-west Yemen, their family of seven was forced to flee amid bombs, missiles, and drone attacks – the twins protected only by blankets.

all_titles.en: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis

articles.title_zh: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
facts_zh:
Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
- Published
Some readers may find this article distressing.
A 54-year-old teacher who survived a mass shooting at an Oregon elementary school said she pretended to be dead so the gunman would not shoot her again.
Becky Drury, a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School, said in a statement shared with US media that as she tried to shut her classroom door, the gunman shot her and she fell to the floor.

all_titles.en: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
